label: Fleet
description: Every app in one strip: up/down, process, requests/min, 5xx, 7-day uptime and the last hour of traffic.

label: Needs attention
description: Everything across the apps that is waiting on you, worst first.

label: Next 7 days
description: Games, bills and todos coming up across the apps.

label: App pulse
description: An app's three or four headline numbers.

label: App status
description: Up/down, process, 5xx in the last hour and the app's background job, in one strip.

label: Health
description: Up/down status and response latency from the health probe.

label: PM2 status
description: Process state, CPU, and memory reported by PM2.

label: Uptime
description: Health-check uptime history as a green/amber/red segment strip.

label: Traffic
description: Requests per minute, 4xx/5xx in the last hour and p95 latency from the nginx access log.

label: Debt-free date
description: When you'll be debt-free at your actual 3-month pace, interest still to pay, and where the next dollar should go.

label: Interest burn
description: What interest costs this month and per day, debt by debt.

label: Paid vs charged
description: Monthly payments against new charges; flags months you charged more than you paid.

label: Balance trajectory
description: Total debt over time with new debts labelled and the projected path to zero.

label: Credit utilization
description: Each card and line of credit against its limit, with the 10% and 30% marks.

label: Income vs spending
description: Monthly income, living costs and debt payoff, with your savings rate.

label: Category movers
description: This month's spending by category against the same days of the last three months.

label: Bills due
description: Debt payments due soon, with minimums and whether they're already covered.

label: Wallet money
description: Money added, withdrawn and still in players' wallets, with a reconciliation check.

label: Money flow
description: Weekly top-ups, game fees, host settlements and withdrawals.

label: Activation funnel
description: Signed up, verified, first game, first paid game, second game.

label: Launch curve
description: Daily signups next to first-time game joins.

label: Comeback rate
description: Share of players who join again, games per player, and who has gone quiet.

label: Invite loop
description: Invites sent and accepted, and the players bringing others in.

label: Game economics
description: Recent and upcoming games: spots filled, fees collected, host paid.

label: Admin to-dos
description: Withdrawals, e-Transfers, refunds, support cases and feedback waiting on you.

label: Spend this month
description: Shopping spend so far this month against last month and your 3-month average, by category.

label: Price creep
description: Items you buy repeatedly, latest price against the first, biggest increases first.

label: Todo flow
description: Todos created vs completed per week, backlog, overdue and time to finish.

label: Custom SQL
description: Render saved custom SQL queries as number, line, bar, or table.
